- real-time controlling of measurements: PM1, PM2.5, PM10, gases, temperature, pressure, air humidity and wind strength and direction,
- adding sensors in locations important to the user to Favorites, in order to find important places like home or work place faster,
- receiving "push" notifications about exceeded air pollution standards in accordance with the user's preferences,
- quick access to information thanks to widgets to be installed on the phone.

According to the WHO, 99% of the world's population breathes polluted air and 2.4 billion people are exposed to dangerous levels of household air pollution. Air pollution causes 7 million people to die prematurely every year due to exposure to pollution. Air quality is a topic that is worth being interested in and monitoring the level of pollution in the place of residence.

Download the Airly app and check what you breathe!
